tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// kye rdo rje dang rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis la gtor 'bul 'bring bsdus cho ga 'khyer bde bzhugs so// 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma yi// zhabs kyi padmor gus btud nas// lha mchog rnam gnyis gtor chog ni// rgyas don snying po bsdus te bri// de'ang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas// nam mkhar e las chos 'byung gsum// padma 'dab brgyad kyis mtshan pa// steng mar oṃ dkar dgu las ni// sku yi rdo rje lha chen brgyad// bar par hūm̐ oṃ las byung ba'i// kye rdor sngon po zhal brgyad dang*// bcu drug phyag dang zhabs bzhi pa// g.yas brkyang rol stabs bdag med yum// zhal sbyor rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// phyi rol gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ// shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ las lha mo brgyad// gau ri nag mo tsau ri dmar// ro langs ma ser za phod ljang*// pukka si sngo ri khrod dkar// gdol mo sngo dmar g.yung mo ljang*// kun kyang g.yon brkyang rol pas bzhugs// pad 'dab brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad las// brgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong sngo// 'og mar āḥdamar dgu las ni// gsung gi rdo rje klu chen brgyad// 'byung po nyer bzhi thams cad kyang*// rdo rje dril 'dzin g.yas brkyang bzhugs// khams gsum 'gro ba sku gsum thim// mig tu gti mug rdo rje sogs nas// thugs kar thugs kyi rdo rje ma// snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams// kye rdor lha dgu sku gsung thugs// rdo rje gsum tshogs spyan drangs thim// dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur bar// gsol btab rdo rje'i chu dbang bskur// lha dgu rang rang rigs bdag dang*// sku gsum rdo rje gsum rgyas gdab// bha ga wān sogs chu bzhi dang*/ lha thams cad kyis ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badzra kā ya waka tsitta tri badzra de wa saṃ gha nāṃ/

i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza dzi gha man chad dkyus ltar brjod pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ puṣpe sogs phyi mchod nang mchod yid byung bstod pa/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar dkyus ltar brjod pas grub bo// 'jigs byed la/ nam mkhar paṃ las padma dang*// a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// dhīḥlas 'jam dpal gser gyi mdog /ral gri glegs bam 'dzin pa'i sku// zhi ba'i rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// de yang 'od du zhu ba las// nyi mar hūm̐ yig cha lnga las// legs skyes rdo rje 'jigs byed ni// ma he'i gdong sogs zhal dgu pa// mthing nag sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /sna tshogs mtshon cha 'phyar zhing 'dzin// bcu drug zhabs kyis srog chags dang*// 'jig rten dregs pa'i rnam par mnan// dur khrod chas rdzogs mtshan ma bsgreng*// gnas gsum 'bru gsum hūm̐ 'od kyis// rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs thim// rigs lnga spyan drangs dbang bskur bas// mi bskyod rdo rjes spyi bor mtshan// zhes lha bskyed nas sngags gsum gyi mthar gtor sngags btags pa gsum sogs kyis phul mthar/ phyi mchod yid mchod bstod pa 'dod gsol rnams dkyus ltar byas pas grub bo// zhes kye rdo rje dang rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis la gtor 'bul 'bring bsdus cho ga 'khyer bde dgos zhes phur tsha bla ma mkhyen rab ngag dbang tshul khrims pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ bande ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// gtor chog dngos grub myur mgyogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse dang*// nus pa'i bdag nyid lhag pa'i lha// bka' sdod srung ma'i gtor chog gi /ngag 'don dngos grub myur mgyogs brtsam// de la'ang bdag mdun gnyis las/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/

bla ma sangs rgyas tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// gzhan don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// kye yi rdo rje bsgom par bgyi// zhes lan gsum/ dngos gzhi la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ chos kun mi dmigs stong par gyur// stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod brgyad// padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du// hūm̐ las bdag nyid he ru ka /sngon po rdo rje thod khrag dang*// kha ṭwāṃ ga rnams mgo phreng dang*// rus rgyan mi lpags stag sham can// spyan gsum mche gtsigs skra ser brdzes// spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan// thal chen gyis byugs g.yas brkyang gis// yi dwags gdan la gar stabs bzhengs// ye shes me 'bar dbus bzhugs pa'i// gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis// rang 'dra spyan drangs dbyer med thim// slar yang rigs lnga spyan drangs nas// dbang bskur mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan// lha sku snang stong sgyu mar blta// bzlas pa bya ba ni/ snying ga'i nyi mar hūm̐ gi mthar// sngags phreng bkod pa'i 'od zer gyis// 'phags pa mchod dang 'gro don byed// rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bdag la bsdus// zhes bsams la/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ spro na/ oṃ badzra karta ri he badzra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan bdag la thun mong mchog /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// zhes pa ni bdag bskyed do// gnyis pa mdun bskyed gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ zlum gtor chab kyis bran te/ oṃ las dngos kun stong pa'i ngang*// āḥlas ye shes thod pa cher// hūm̐ las lnga gsum bdud rtsis bkang*// hoḥyis dbyer med bdud rtsir gyur// zhes pas bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ mgron spyan 'dren ni/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// he ru ka dpal spyan drangs gyur// ljags las 'od kyi sbu gu byung*// gtor ma bzhes pas mnyes par gyur// oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lan gsum/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// kye yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la// dngos grub zung gi skal ba stsol// zhes pas yi dam la phul/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes pas spel la/ gtor mgron bskyed pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad nyi ror// hūm̐ skyes rdo rje nag po che// rab khros zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// gri gug thod pa gaṇḍī bsnams// mgo phreng sbrul rus stag sham brgyan// me dpung klong na zlum stabs bzhugs// sprul pa'i pho nya lnga sde 'phro// g.yon du ṭaṃ las ral gcig sngo// ral pa g.yon 'phyang bum pa can// de yi lto bar khrag mtsho'i nang*// bhyoḥlas 'dod khams dbang phyug ma// phyag bzhi'i gri thod mdung rtse gsum// 'dzin cing bong bu gwa dmar zhon// srin mo 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs// lcam dral thugs las ya mma chad// mdun du pad ma nyi ma'i steng*// ya las nag po gnod sbyin yab// mi lpags gos gyon gri thod bsnams// mma las nag mo gnod sbyin mo// spu gri thod 'chang ber nag bklubs// yab las tri tri yum las bhyoḥ /mdun du spros las pu tra mthing*// ral gri 'phyar zhing thod khrag 'dzin// dar nag 'jol ber sku la gsol// bha ṭa nag po stag slog gyon// dam shing 'phyar zhing dgra snying 'dred// bhyoḥskyes srin mo kha 'bar ma// spu gri rgyu zhags 'dren ma ste// 'khor du ru 'dren pho nyas bskor// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od kyis// gur mgon lcam dral las mgon tshogs// tshur spyon badzra sa mā dzaḥ spro na/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs dpal mgon tshogs// bstan pa srung dang bdag cag gi

/bsam don 'grub phyir 'dir bzhugs gsol// sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥso sor thim// zhes brjod la thams cad kyis gtor ma bzhes par bsam zhing*/ thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye/ sarba karma nā the bhyaḥs pa ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba lyā di swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ oṃ sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pa dyaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ bar gyis phyi mchod/ oṃ sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan bsrungs/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod dbang thang mi rgyud chos rgyud dang bcas pa rgyun mi chad par 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las dang stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ chos dang srid pa'i dpal gang dag /bsam don gsol ba btab tsam gyis// bde blag bsgrub pa'i mthu rtsal can// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas bstod// bstan srung khyed rnams bdag cag gi /mgon skyabs rten gling mchog gsol na// sde bzhi dge bcu'i dpal thams cad// bskyed pa'i rtsa lag mchog tu mdzod// tshe srog gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar bsring*// bsod nams ri bo'i spun zlar brling*// dbang thang rigs rgyud sprin dus kyi// chu gter lta bu 'phel rgyas mdzod// ces dang*/ tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i bar// thugs dang 'gal ba gang bgyis pa// bzod par bzhes nas rten 'di la// brtan bzhugs bkra shis dam pas skyongs// zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor ro// smras pa/

bstan srung mgon po mnyes mchod kyi// ngag 'don nyung gsal bgyis pa'i dge /bstan srung yid bzhin nor bu yi// re ba'i shing rta 'gengs phyir bsngo// zhes yi dam bka' sdod bcas pa'i gtor chog dngos grub myur mgyogs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lha lcam bskal bzang sgrol ma'i zhal 'don du/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa ka lyā ṇa bha wantu// // ༄༅// dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi 'dod gsol nyung 'dus bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ dur khrod yab yum rten 'di la// brtan bzhugs sbyin bdag 'khor du bcas// nad rims gdon bgegs 'tshe ba rnams// mi 'byung bsrung dang zhi bar mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams 'bru nor sogs// dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas pa dang*// lha 'dre mi rigs kun byams zhing*// chags 'dun dbang du 'du bar mdzod// gzhi byes kun du dgra bgegs dang*// chom rkun mi srun 'tshe ba rnams// bcings dang mnan dang phyir bzlog cing*// tshar gcod drag po'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this ma hā tha nu tsau bandha bandha swā hā/ zhes dur khrod bdag po'i sku la bri rgyu'i phrin las 'chol ba 'di'ang tshul rin gyis so// //oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ rgyal ba'i phrin las lhun grub sgyu ma'i gar// mthu ldan nor sbyong yab yum rten 'di la// brtan par bzhugs nas sgrub pa'i gnas khang 'dir// chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor tshe// bde dga' longs spyod phun sum tshogs dgu rnams// bung bas padma'i bcud bzhin tshur bsdus la// 'dod dgu mi zad gter la dbang 'byor mdzod// khyad par rin chen gter dang lo legs 'bru// dkar thog ja bzang la sogs bza' btung rigs// dar zab dro 'jam bgo ba rta phyugs rnams// rnam thos bu yi mnga' thang spun zlar mdzod// sarba siddhi pra yatstshantu//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
